text:
Omar (oncall): Seeing a sudden 3x latency spike for apac-1 inference pool, error-rate up ~18% on /v1/generate. Noticing many requests stuck at kv-cache deserialization step.
Jin (runtime): Confirmed. Traces show long GC/hang inside kvcache deserializer after last runtime rollout (yesterday 22:18).
Maya (infra): apac hotpool GPU utilisation jumped from 60% -> 95% around the same time. Could be backlog + deserialization stalls.
Priya (sre): Any automatic fallback kicking in? Are we spilling to NA? Metrics show region-slo breaches.
ops-bot: Alert: apac-1-region > latency_SLO_violation (p95 1.9s -> 6.4s), error_rate 18% (threshold 5%).
Leo (runtime): I rolled a small patch to kernel selector yesterday (kernel-optim v2). It touched model quant paths and the kvcache serialize/deser path. Rolling back now?
Jin (runtime): Agree rollback looks safe. But need immediate mitigation: reduce batcher max_batch_size and enable kv-cache bypass for problematic model family to unblock in-flight requests.
Maya (infra): Spinning up reserved hotpool nodes in apac while rerouting non-SLO-critical traffic to na1. Will also drain affected nodes for investigation.
Omar (oncall): @Maya please use the emergency reserve we agreed last quarter. Tag the cost center. We need capacity now.
Maya (infra): Started hotpool spin: provision request id prov-AP-3942. ETA ~90s for new GPUs. Also increasing soft limit on apac-burst.
deploy-bot: Rolling config change: runtime.batch.max_size=8 -> 4 in apac-1 (initiated by Jin). Change id: cfg-8791.
Jin (runtime): Applied kv-cache bypass toggle for model-family redwood/opt-* in apac-1: kv_bypass=true. This will hit token cost but reduces deserialization path.
Sara (infra): Traffic reroute in progress: ~12% of traffic to na1 (non-low-latency). Using steering policy policy:geo-ephemeral-2026.
Alex (sre): Observability note: enabled verbose kvcache logs on drained nodes to capture stack traces, pushed to ephemeral retention (48h).
Omar (oncall): Log snippet from one stuck request:
```
2026-06-12T14:21:03Z runtime[kvcache]: deserializer: waiting for buffer lock
2026-06-12T14:21:03Z runtime[kvcache]: deserializer: decompress_chunk() timeout after 30s
2026-06-12T14:21:03Z runtime[runtime]: request id=R-71a3 stalled at kvcache deserialize
```
Jin (runtime): That decompress timeout is new — likely introduced by the kernel change. Rolling runtime back to kernel-optim v1 now (rollback id rb-1120).
deploy-bot: Rollback triggered: rb-1120 (kernel-optim v1). Expected completion 60s.
Maya (infra): Hotpool nodes online. Capacity added + spill to na1 completed. Early telemetry shows decreased queue depth.
Priya (sre): After config change and rollback, p95 dropped from 6.4s -> 2.1s within 3 minutes. Error rate trending down to 6%. Still above target but improving.
Leo (runtime): Rollback completed. KVCACHE logs no longer showing decompress timeouts on new nodes. We should keep kv_bypass until we validate.
Omar (oncall): Agree keep kv_bypass for 30m for safety. Track cost delta.
Maya (infra): Noted. Hotpool + reroute cost ~additional $1.2k/hr for APAC while active. Documenting on incident board.
Priya (sre): Can we schedule a short postmortem runbook: repro steps, kernel diff, and a mitigation playbook (hotpool spin, kv_bypass, batch-size change, reroute). Also add automated alert on kvcache decompress timeouts.
Jin (runtime): I'll prepare a changelist to remove the regressions and add more unit tests around kvcache compress/decompress.
Alex (sre): Will open a follow-up incident ticket and assign owners: runtime (Jin/Leo), infra (Maya/Sara), cost (Omar).
Omar (oncall): Thanks everyone. Keeping this thread for resolution notes. Will update after 30m verification window. :thumbsup:
Sara (infra): 30m check-in scheduled at 14:55 UTC.
ops-bot: Incident state -> mitigation in place.
Omar (oncall): After 30m: p95 stable ~1.9s, error_rate 2.2%. Closing mitigation steps, leaving kv_bypass on until PR validated. Will file for rollback gate once tests pass.
Priya (sre): Postmortem owner assigned: Priya. Draft due EOD tomorrow. Include cost impact and SLA exposure.
Jin (runtime): Adding integration tests and will run a canary with kernel-optim v2 behind feature flag next week.
Maya (infra): Hotpool drained and will be deprovisioned in 12m. Cost estimated for incident: ~$3.6k.
Omar (oncall): Closing thread. Great coordination.
